page_title: TOR 1-5 COM | Torino v Como 24/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Jean Butez (Como).
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Como are seeing far more of the ball now.

86' 1 - 5 Martin Baturina (Como) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Alberto Paleari is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:5.
84' Substitution. Maximo Perrone walks off the pitch and Stefan Posch (Como) comes on as a substitute.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Martin Baturina (Como) comes onto the pitch so that Nico Paz can be given a rest.
78' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Alieu Njie (Torino) replaces Duvan Zapata.
78' Substitution. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) replaces Nikola Vlasic.
78' 1 - 4 Referee Kevin Bonacina points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Nico Paz (Como) goes wild in celebration.
78' Como score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
75' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Jesus Rodriguez is replaced by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alvaro Morata as he is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Como).

75' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) blew a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross deep inside the box, but his shot flew just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
74' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:5.

71' 1 - 3 Maximo Perrone produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Jacobo Ramon (Como) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:3.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.

70' CHANCE! Jesus Rodriguez (Como) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
69' Torino keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession.
68' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Valentino Lazaro (Torino) but poses no threat.
66' Substitution. Cyril Ngonge makes way for Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino).
66' Substitution. Cesare Casadei leaves the pitch and is replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Torino).
65' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
61' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Marcus Pedersen will be replaced by Niels Nkounkou (Torino).
59' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
57' We are about to witness a substitution. Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is replacing Ivan Smolcic.

52' 1 - 2 Brilliant finish! Jayden Addai (Como) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Jesus Rodriguez, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:2.
52' Adrien Tameze (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.

49' Duvan Zapata (Torino) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the left post. Poor header! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
48' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
47' Como fail to score from a corner as Alberto Paleari (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.

47' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Como will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' 1 - 1 Nikola Vlasic (Torino) confidently powers his spot-kick into the left side of the goal.
45+2' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+1' Referee Kevin Bonacina is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Torino!
45+1' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
45+1' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Torino!
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' The resulting corner from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
42' A cross into the box from Jayden Addai (Como) is cleared. Now Como have a corner.
42' Como work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
41' Jayden Addai (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Como are awarded a corner kick.
40' The ball possession at the moment is 31:69.

39' Jayden Addai (Como) bursts into the penalty area with the ball at his feet after a wonderful individual effort that left fans breathless and in awe. However, he sends the ball in a completely different direction than intended, well wide of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
36' 0 - 1 Jesus Rodriguez feeds the ball through to Jayden Addai (Como), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly drills it into the roof of the net! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!

36' A fine individual run by Kristjan Asllani (Torino) culminates with a rocket of a shot from long range, but the ball fizzes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
34' Alvaro Morata (Como) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
33' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Como! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Kevin Bonacina and both teams have no complaints.
32' Referee Kevin Bonacina makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
28' Alvaro Morata (Como) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Alberto Paleari makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
25' A player from Torino commits a rough challenge. Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Como earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

23' Duvan Zapata (Torino) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
21' Ivan Smolcic (Como) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
19' Nico Paz (Como) commits a rough foul. Kevin Bonacina stops the game and makes a call. A free kick is awarded to Torino.
18' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
16' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
15' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
14' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
13' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
11' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) plays a through ball but overhits it.
9' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) sends a long ball in, but Alberto Paleari comfortably gathers the ball.
7' Flag up against Duvan Zapata (Torino). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
5' Alvaro Morata (Como) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
5' A spell of possession for Como in an attempt to control the game.
3' Como exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Kevin Bonacina got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
